author: Unreal Engine
description:
Watch this video to see the impressive digital character work being created with MetaHuman by talented teams around the world.

As the MetaHuman framework becomes more powerful, we’re seeing some fantastic examples of just how far it’s possible to push the technology. 

The projects in this video span industries as diverse as games, film & TV, animation, broadcast & live events, and beyond. Take a look and get a glimpse at what you can achieve with MetaHuman.

Want to start creating your own realistic digital humans? Check out our website: metahuman.com.
